limitations: All manufacturer solids and open surfaces are retained at their original millimetre scale. Only the documented rigid centering/rotation is applied.
CAD/photo colours are approximate display choices; no measured optical material or hardware fit validation is asserted.
Header-installed, IPEX-antenna and memory SKU variants retain independent product identities but this model shows the documented base PCB; their mechanical differences are not separately rendered.
USB geometry is retained from manufacturer CAD; no cable anchor or electrical connection is exposed without a verified pin-side orientation.

The current source photo includes a large RF shield absent from this published STEP. Its height and mounting were not supplied; the missing shield is a recorded CAD/photo deviation, not silently invented geometry.
